title: What’s up
html_source: ‘Hi, how are things, what are ye up to’. A Greeting and 2 questions, all in 2 words. The polite answer is ‘nothing much’ or ‘this and that’. But it depends on circumstance.Its still in use today, I’m surprised to find its so old. The Brothers surly response to this mangled English is typically of the Catholic Church.
